tools.name: get_wifi_facts
tools.description: Best answer for "will this flight have WiFi". Predicts the WiFi provider for a flight number on a given date, with probability, the tail number expected to operate it, aircraft type, and the airline fleet fallback. Prefer this over get_flight_wifi.

tools.name: get_flight_wifi
tools.description: Shorter WiFi lookup for a flight number: provider, confidence, airline, aircraft, and Starlink status. Use get_wifi_facts instead when you need the date, tail number, or reasoning.

tools.name: get_airline_wifi
tools.description: WiFi providers an airline uses fleet-wide, plus a fleet summary and whether WiFi is free. Use when the question is about the airline rather than one flight.

tools.name: get_rollouts
tools.description: Starlink and satellite WiFi rollout progress per aircraft type: status (complete, in_progress, planned, announced), fleet percentage, and expected completion. Omit airline_code for every tracked airline.

tools.name: get_speed_stats
tools.description: Crowd-sourced in-flight WiFi speed reports: average download/upload Mbps, latency, and a per-provider breakdown. Use for "is the WiFi fast enough" questions. Pass a flight_number or an airline_code, not both.

tools.name: get_tail_info
tools.description: WiFi provider history for one aircraft by tail number, including crowd-sourced reports and fleet assignment. Use when the exact airframe is known.

tools.name: search_wifi
tools.description: Free-text search across airlines and flights when you only have a name or partial term. Use a specific tool instead when you already have a flight number, airline code, or tail number.

tools.name: list_airlines
tools.description: Every airline SeatWiFi tracks, with its WiFi providers. Large response — use search_wifi or get_airline_wifi when you know which airline you want.
